title: 交换键盘!幽幽的奇思妙想
description: My keyboard is no longer mine!!! When there are two players in the world, use /luo swap true to enable it!
body:
## 当我们的键盘再也不属于自己! 1.确保世界中存在两名玩家
2.使用/luo swap true来开启键盘交换
3.排除了sec和/ 可以正常输入指令

使用/luo swap false关闭键盘交换
目前小游戏只支持26.1.2fabric
左下角键盘出现则开启成功,游戏会交换所有键盘按键(排除sec和/)
如有发现问题,请前往发布视频联系我
友尽小游戏,快试试看吧!
## 灵感来源 当我看见这种有趣的小游戏但是需要线下面对面交换蓝牙键盘,我认为这太繁琐了,而且线上玩家无法做到.
这个模组彻底解决了这个问题,完美交换了各自的键盘 ## 发布视频[视频链接](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1AREH6DEL6) ## When Our Keyboards No Longer Belong to Us! 1. Ensure there are two players in the world. 2. Use `/luo swap true` to enable keyboard swapping. 3. Excluding `sec` and `/` allows normal input of commands. Use `/luo swap false` to disable keyboard swapping. Currently, the game only supports version 26.1.2 of Fabric. If the keyboard appears in the lower left corner, it's successfully enabled; the game will swap all keyboard keys (excluding `sec` and `/`). If you encounter any problems, please contact me through the uploaded video. A friendship-ending mini-game, give it a try! ## Inspiration When I saw this fun mini-game that required face-to-face Bluetooth keyboard swapping, I thought it was too cumbersome, and online players couldn't do it. This module completely solves this problem, perfectly swapping keyboards. [video](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1AREH6DEL6)
